abilities.name: Firing line
abilities.description: If this unit has not moved this round and was not deployed at the start of the turn, add 1 to the attack characteristic of this unit's Muskets for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Curved Armored Plating
abilities.description: When saving against wounds from Archery attacks, this unit can add +1 on its save roll.

abilities.name: Mercenary Training
abilities.description: You can use one point of personal wealth on this unit to increase each tokens health by 1, their control by 2, and their movement by 2. Furthermore, all of the weapons of that unit gain Crit (Auto-wound).
